solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Tan then, but briefly, as perilous?

definitions.note: to tan is to lie in the sun to brown the skin

indicators.note: something perilous is in a dangerous, unstable state, so these letters are thrown into a new order
said briefly, the words lose their final letter

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether getting a quick tan was risky back then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' cuts the T from BUT, leaving BU; 'perilous' shuffles THEN, BU and AS together.
explanation.definitionFit: Tanning, used as a verb, means lying out so the skin browns under solar rays.

clue.text: Holy scriptures are commonly read every day, first of all

indicators.note: first of all asks for the opening letter of every one of the following words

explanation.surface: Religious texts are, people say, read daily.
explanation.definitionFit: Holy and sacred are synonyms, both describing what is consecrated to a deity.

clue.text: Song more insensitive?

definitions.meaning: a ... is a piece of music performed, as in a musical ...
read as NUMB plus ER, the comparative: more lacking feeling

explanation.definitionFit: A song in a show is a number; and numb with -er makes a comparative of lacking sensation.

clue.text: A loose woman in the family

parts.note: to loose a knot, as a verb, is to untie it

explanation.surface: Suggests a promiscuous woman among one's relations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loose woman' reads as one phrase, but 'loose' is a verb meaning undo.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's sister is a female relative, so she is a woman in your family.

clue.text: Do in wicked youth with spear

indicators.note: wicked means badly behaved or twisted, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sinister scene: someone is killed by a nasty young man armed with a spear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do in' looks like the phrase meaning kill, but 'Do' alone is the definition and 'in' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A do is informal British for a party or social occasion, such as a gathering at a country home.

clue.text: Wind from America behind plane

indicators.note: behind says the American piece comes after the plane piece

parts.note: a plane is a flat surface
US is the abbreviation for the United States, America

explanation.surface: Wind blowing from across the Atlantic behind an aircraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plane' suggests an aircraft and 'Wind' the weather; here wind is gas in the gut.
explanation.definitionFit: This medical word means gas in the bowel, wind in the digestive sense.

clue.text: Seen in diary, a slight feeling of revulsion

indicators.note: seen in says the following pieces appear inside the diary piece

parts.note: a log is a daily record, such as a ship's diary
slight in build means thin

explanation.surface: Someone notes a faint disgust recorded in a journal.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense hatred or disgust is a strong feeling of revulsion.

clue.text: Churning later observed in part of body — stomach

indicators.note: observed in says the shuffled letters are found inside the body part

parts.note: a toe is a part of the body

indicators.note: churning means stirring up, so the letters of the word later are mixed

explanation.surface: A digestive picture: something churning later in the stomach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stomach' reads as the body organ the surface describes, but it is a verb meaning endure.
explanation.definitionFit: To stomach something is to put up with or endure it, an idiomatic verb sense.

clue.text: Winger Jack embraced by supporter

indicators.note: embraced by means held inside the supporter piece

parts.note: a sling supports an injured arm
jack and tar are both words for a sailor

explanation.surface: A football winger called Jack is hugged by a fan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winger' and 'supporter' set up football, but the winger is a bird and the supporter a sling.
explanation.definitionFit: A winger is a creature with wings, and this common songbird is one.

clue.text: Dynasty stopping putsch in a few moments

indicators.note: stopping means plugging a gap, so the dynasty sits inside the putsch

parts.note: a putsch is a coup, a sudden seizure of power
the Ming was a Chinese dynasty

explanation.surface: A ruling house is about to halt an attempted takeover.
explanation.definitionFit: Something approaching soon is about to happen, i.e. arriving shortly.

clue.text: Old man meeting girl, Spanish dish

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father, one's old man
Ella is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Dad meets a young woman over a Spanish meal.
explanation.definitionFit: This rice dish with seafood and saffron comes from Valencia in Spain.

clue.text: Cosmetic overhaul of English river in Sussex town

indicators.note: an overhaul rebuilds something, so these letters are reassembled

parts.note: the Nile is the African river
Rye is a small town in East Sussex, southern England

explanation.surface: Plans to revamp an English river running through a Sussex town.
explanation.walkthrough: E stays at the front; 'overhaul of' rearranges NILE and RYE together, and 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This make-up product draws a line along the lid, a type of cosmetic.

clue.text: Hot pink clothes for singers

indicators.note: clothes, as a verb, means wraps around, so the pink piece surrounds the hot piece

parts.note: coral is a pinkish colour
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Bright pink garments for a group of vocalists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothes' looks like a noun but is a verb: CORAL dresses H.
explanation.definitionFit: Music written for a choir is for an ensemble of voices, so it suits singers.

clue.text: Programme on top horse

indicators.note: on, in a down clue, says the programme piece sits above the top piece

parts.note: a show is a television programme
a jumper is a top, a knitted pullover

explanation.surface: A broadcast featuring a champion racehorse.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse trained to clear fences in arena competitions is one example of an equestrian animal.

clue.text: Weight put behind domestic chore in US state

indicators.note: put behind says the weight piece comes after the chore piece

parts.note: doing the washing is a household chore
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: Someone is stuck with more housework somewhere in America.
explanation.definitionFit: This Pacific Northwest region is one of the fifty American states.

clue.text: Over sink, store kitchen vessel

indicators.note: over, in a down clue, says the store piece sits above the sink piece

parts.note: stock is a store of goods
to pot a ball in snooker is to sink it

explanation.surface: Instructions to keep a cooking pan above the kitchen sink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sink' looks like a kitchen basin but is a verb, as in sinking a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: A large deep pan for simmering broth is a cooking vessel used in the kitchen.

clue.text: Coloured fluid upset, water ruined fleece perhaps?

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the fluid is read upwards

parts.note: ink is a coloured fluid for writing

indicators.note: ruined means wrecked, so the letters of water are jumbled

explanation.surface: Spilled ink and water have spoiled a woolly garment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns INK to KNI; 'ruined' turns WATER into TWEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A fleece is a soft warm top, an example of a woolly garment; hence the question mark.

clue.text: Repair lets tree put down roots again

indicators.note: to repair is to rebuild, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Mending allows a tree to take root once more.
explanation.definitionFit: To move and establish a home once more is to put down roots in a fresh place.

clue.text: Unfortunate case of thespian, lowest in Hollywood

indicators.note: unfortunate means unlucky, things gone awry, so the letters are mixed
the case of a word is its outside, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: An unlucky actor at rock bottom in the film capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case of' gives TN from thespian; 'Unfortunate' shuffles TN, LOWEST and IN. 'in' looks like a link but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A mocking nickname for the film district of Los Angeles, alluding to its glitz.

clue.text: Torpedo almost exploding daily

indicators.note: exploding means blown apart, so the remaining letters are scattered
almost means not quite the whole word, so its final letter goes

explanation.surface: A torpedo that very nearly blows up every day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims TORPEDO to TORPED, which 'exploding' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A red-top is a British tabloid newspaper, a daily paper with a red masthead such as The Sun.

clue.text: Nanny claiming third in wheelbarrow race

indicators.note: claiming means taking hold of, so the nanny piece surrounds the letter

parts.note: a nanny is a carer for children

indicators.note: third in asks for the third letter of the word wheelbarrow

explanation.surface: A childminder enters a wheelbarrow race.
explanation.definitionFit: To career is to rush along headlong at speed, a verb sense of racing.

clue.text: Warmer island off southern England

definitions.meaning: a warmer here is a knitted pullover worn for warmth
the largest Channel Island lies in the English Channel off the south coast

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a woollen sweater and the largest of the Channel Islands.

clue.text: Clydebank's first complete ship

indicators.note: first asks for the opening letter of the Scottish place name

parts.note: utter means complete, as in utter nonsense

explanation.surface: The first finished vessel from the Clydebank shipyards.
explanation.definitionFit: A small fast sailing vessel or patrol boat is a kind of ship.

clue.text: Join end of queue after delay — some flier!

indicators.note: after says the end of the queue comes behind the delay piece

parts.note: to fuse is to join together
a lag is a delay

indicators.note: end of asks for the final letter of the word queue

explanation.surface: A traveller joins the back of a long airport queue after a hold-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some flier' means part of an aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the main body of an aeroplane, so it is some, a part, of a flying machine.

clue.text: Decidedly bewitching

definitions.meaning: as an adverb, it means fairly or considerably, as in a fairly good result

explanation.definitionFit: The word works as an adverb meaning quite or considerably, and as an adjective meaning attractive.

clue.text: Clean — unlike Dalmatian?

definitions.meaning: a Dalmatian dog is covered in spots, so something unlike it has none

explanation.definitionFit: It means perfectly clean, and taken literally it means without spots, the opposite of a Dalmatian's coat.

clue.text: Country that may be stuffed

definitions.meaning: a nation spanning Europe and Asia, capital Ankara
a festive bird roasted with stuffing at Christmas or Thanksgiving

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a nation straddling Europe and Asia and a large bird often roasted with stuffing.

clue.text: Work around cable, getting last of water for well

indicators.note: around says the work piece goes about the other letters

parts.note: to ply a trade is to work at it
a rope is a thick cable

indicators.note: last of asks for the final letter of the word water

explanation.surface: Fitting a cable to a well to draw water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well' looks like a water source but is an adverb meaning correctly.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in a correct, suitable manner, i.e. doing something well.
